title: Rust and Roots
role: The Salvage's map and its rooms: the first layer, walked most. Curious and a little melancholy, never sleepy; it must not tire over a long map.
theme: The motif in A minor (A E A C B A), as a lilting waltz: the first place the player meets it after the title.
form: silence 1, intro 4 (harp), verse 8 (cello), verse 8 (flute answers), bridge 8 (C major, warmer), verse 8, bridge 8 (its ending turns back home), outro 2
style: melancholy acoustic fantasy exploration, video game map music, instrumental, no vocals, solo cello melody, wooden flute, plucked harp, soft piano, gentle waltz, ruined workshop, curious and warm, clear intimate recording, A minor, 108 BPM, 3/4
